li.label: my home town was razed
li.description: The place I grew up is gone. Burned to the ground. Everyone I knew there...

li.label: my home town was conquered
li.description: Foreigners rule the place I come from now.

li.label: my home town was plundered
li.description: Raiders looted the town I come from. I hope my family is all right.

li.label: we helped my home town
li.description: Our colony sent help to the town I come from when it needed it. That means a lot to me.

li.label: marked for vengeance
li.description: Someone out there has sworn to kill me for what I did. I keep looking over my shoulder.

li.label: blood feud over
li.description: The one sworn to kill me won't be coming any more. I can breathe again.
